This is supported by a chain of interactions where the compound is identified as a target of 5,8-Dihydroxy-7,4'-dimethoxyflavone, which in turn targets ATR. The evidence indicates a possible pathway where the compound may modulate ATR activity through its interaction with the transporter Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, which is involved in the transport of the flavone. The strength of the relationship is indicated by a final score of 0.4719, suggesting a moderate level of confidence in the proposed interaction. The mechanism involves the compound potentially influencing ATR through the transporter, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
